dog.description_text: Praline’s foster was filling out her update when she looked down to find this sweet girl sleeping between her feet, using one as a pillow. That’s Praline. Always finding a little way to be close to someone she loves. She is 3 months old and about 20 pounds. She loves chasing a ball, wrestling with her stuffed toys, and investigating the world with her very impressive nose. But when those puppy eyes get sleepy, she’ll tuck herself beside you and settle in like there’s nowhere else she’d rather be. Praline has been sharing her foster home with a dog and two cats, and she did wonderfully with the children in her previous foster home. She adores people, loves other dogs, and would be thrilled to have a playful canine friend. With the cats, she’s curious and respectful, perfectly happy to let them do their own thing. Praline already knows “sit” and “touch,” is learning her name, and takes her training very seriously when treats are involved. She’s making steady progress with puppy pads, getting comfortable in her crate, and learning her puppy manners with a family cheering her on. Her foster calls her “honestly a great puppy,” and we couldn’t be happier watching her grow. Praline is looking for a family who will make time for play, help her keep learning, and always leave a little room beside them for a girl who loves this much. Apply to adopt Praline at rescuecity.nyc.
dog.name: Praline
